walkthroughs.body_html: German nouns have three genders: der (masculine), die (feminine), das (neuter). 'Der Vater', 'die Mutter'. Learn the article with the noun.
Der Bruder = brother. Die Schwester = sister. Plurals: die Bruder, die Schwestern. All nouns get capital letters in German.
Ich habe = I have. 'Ich habe einen Bruder und zwei Schwestern' = 'I have one brother and two sisters'.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between 'ich will' and 'ich möchte'?
options: Ich will = I want (strong, direct); ich möchte = I would like (polite).
